question: What have some people tried to manage their hirsutism?
answer: Some people have tried spearmint tea and spironolactone 50mg to manage their hirsutism, although individual results may vary and some may not find these methods effective [Source: What truly helped your hirsutism? : r/PCOS - Reddit]. Please consult a healthcare provider for personalized advice.
